This
document outlines the equipment inspection
I1, which must be performed
on a monthly bases 
as indicated by M1 in the above title block.

The 
first draft initiated at 
Ayon Moussa PS, East Delta 
Electricity Production Company
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff must carry the suitable ID safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is required,

items: A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff must carry the suitable ID safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is required,

Wear the appropriate 
 safety equipment as safety 
 shoes, helmet, breathing mask, safety glasses,

The circuit breaker 
 should be switched off, fully 
 isolated, and grounded 
 on both sides,
Earthing switch must be closed on both sides of the breaker,
Switch off control current for CB (d.c).

sections.text:
Environmental 
Precautions

Before using a blower to clean the outside compartment of the 
circuit breaker from dust, wear your breathing mask to 
protect your lung tissues from the dust 
particulate.

items:
Before using a blower to clean the outside compartment of the 
circuit breaker from dust, wear your breathing mask to 
protect your lung tissues from the dust 
particulate.

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items: Complete tool set,
SF6 gas detector,
Air blower, and rags,

Safety helmet, shoes, glove, and
 breathing mask,

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out
Visual inspection for all parts of circuit breaker.

Check 
AC supply source.
Check DC supply source.
Record on / off operations counter and compare with the previous month.
Record the oil pump operations counter.

Earth 
connections must be checked.

Clean 
all outside compartment of circuit breaker from dust, oil and other things using 
blower and rags.
Retighten all bolts and earth connection parts if necessary.
Visual inspection of foundation and fixation of circuit breaker.
Complete cleaning for mechanism parts.

Check 
oil level of main tanks for three phases.

Check 
oil leaks for all connections.

Check 
the heater operation.

Check 
door gaskets for all panels.
